scripts.preinstall: node -e "for (const file of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) { try { require('node:fs').rmSync(file); } catch {} } if (!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '').startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build:vercel: corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push:vercel && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/focusarx run build:vercel
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run typecheck
